items.raw_excerpt: Moving to a new country always comes with a learning curve, but for English speakers in Norway, the local language can lead to some truly surprising and hilarious moments, as Irene Andrade explains.

items.summary_en: Officials in Brittany say the Saint-Malo area has about 75 days of drinking water left. They ask residents to use less. The Route du Rhum race is expected to bring 1.5 million visitors soon.

items.raw_excerpt: This one can be used to remind yourself to make the most of the outdoors, even if the Norwegian weather isn't playing ball.
items.summary_en: This Norwegian saying means: go outside for a walk, and do not come home grumpy. It tells people to enjoy the outdoors even when the weather is bad. The words for walk and grumpy in it are simple ones, so it is a good first phrase to learn.

items.title_en: Norwegian phrase of the day: Out for a walk, never grumpy

items.raw_excerpt: Valar Atomics wants to place over 450 reactors on more than 9,500 acres in Utah to power a huge data center project.
items.summary_en: A Utah startup called Valar Atomics wants to build a huge data center that runs on nuclear power. The company plans to put more than 450 small reactors on about 9,500 acres of public land. Some people near the site worry about safety, water use, and what will happen to the land.
items.summary_ko: 유타의 스타트업 밸러 아톰식은 원전으로 전기를 공급하는 거대한 데이터센터를 짓고 싶어 한다. 회사는 연방 토지 약 9,500에이커에 소형 원자로 450개 넘게 놓을 계획을 세웠다. 주변에는 원전 안전과 물 사용량, 토지를 다 쓸 수 있는지를 두고 우려도 나온다.
items.title_en: A startup wants to build a nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah

items.raw_excerpt: Need to register your address in Austria or been asked for a Meldezettel? Here’s what the term means and how Austria’s compulsory address-registration system works.

items.raw_excerpt: Most data centres in the Netherlands do not make their environmental impact public, which conceals water and electricity usage, according to an investigation by Trouw and Lighthouse Reports. The Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO), which collects data on behalf of the EU, lists only 104 data centres but the industry body Dutch Datacenter Association (DDA) says there were 186 commercial data centres at the end of 2025. These figures cover data centres with at least 500 kW of installed IT capacity
items.summary_en: An investigation by Trouw and Lighthouse Reports says most data centers in the Netherlands do not publish how much water and electricity they use. The government agency RVO lists 104 data centers, but the industry group DDA says there were 186 at the end of 2025.
items.summary_ko: 트루와 라이트하우스 리포트의 조사에 따르면 네덜란드 대부분의 데이터센터가 물과 전력 사용량을 공개하지 않고 있습니다. 정부 기관 RVO는 데이터센터 104곳을 집계했지만, 업계 단체 DDA는 2025년 말 기준 186곳이라고.maps합니다.
items.title_en: Most Big Dutch Data Centers Hide Their Energy Use
